name: RoadTextVQA train-background IDF lexical router second fresh OCR replay
question: Can independently estimated background video frequency distinguish identity-bearing target tokens from common street text, improving the legacy router without wrong or ambiguous candidates?
observed_before_freeze: The first thirty-video roster-only successor improved correct 9 to 15 and UNKNOWN 15 to 3, but produced 11 ambiguous and one wrong episode.
Its contaminating short tokens were common across unrelated scenes, including home, king, express, grand, auto, deli, super, body, hair, and depot.
A sealed scan of 2,635 training videos yielded video-document frequency for 64,090 OCR tokens. The next panel is disjoint from the consumed development video and all thirty first-panel videos.

selection_state_at_freeze.selection_rule: Thirty fixed, one-video-per-row place or business name questions from validation annotations, excluding every OCR-exposed video.

token_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKD ASCII fold, lowercase alphanumeric individual OCR tokens; source full-text summary excluded.
token_contract.information_formula: For each matched roster-unique target token, log2((2635+1)/(training_video_document_frequency+1)); sum distinct token bits across the ten-frame sequence.
token_contract.association: Four- and five-character target tokens require exact OCR; length six or longer permits edit distance one. A token must appear in exactly one fixed roster target. Candidate requires at least eight background-information bits; exactly one matching target is accepted.
token_contract.authority: Search-priority target-name candidate only; no pixel text localization, sign-to-entity association, exact physical identity, facade, portal, entrance, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, or safety authority.

synthetic_negative_contract.formula: For each fixed row, SHA256(question_id|video|salt), map the first ten hex nibbles to letters a-p, then prefix zz.
synthetic_negative_contract.authority: Generated absent-query canaries only; not human-verified scene target-absence truth.

execution_rule: Run exactly once. Do not change selected rows, excluded videos, IDF corpus, eight-bit threshold, token lengths, edit distance, roster uniqueness, or gate after observing selected OCR.

claim_boundary.allowed: Development evidence for background-calibrated lexical search-priority routing on a second fresh OCR-unseen RoadTextVQA validation panel.
not_allowed: benchmark-test, blind, independent, provider-controlled, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, deployment, product, benefit, reliability, or safety confirmation
pixel text localization or a token proving exact physical entity identity, sign ownership, facade ownership, portal ownership, or entrance ownership
public access, traversability, waypoint correctness, arrival, or handoff
